title: Into Your Hand I Commit My Spirit

questions.question: In you, O Lord, do I take refuge; let me never be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:1 (ESV): "In you, O Lord, do I take refuge; let me never be put to shame;"

questions.question: In your righteousness deliver me; incline your what to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:2 (ESV): "In your righteousness deliver me; incline your ear to me;"

questions.question: Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:2 (ESV): "...rescue me speedily! Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to save me!"

questions.question: For you are my rock and my fortress; and for your name's sake you lead me and do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:3 (ESV): "For you are my rock and my fortress; and for your name's sake you lead me and guide me;"

questions.question: Into your hand I commit my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:5 (ESV): "Into your hand I commit my spirit;"

questions.question: You have redeemed me, O Lord, faithful God. I hate those who pay regard to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:6 (ESV): "I hate those who pay regard to worthless idols, but I trust in the Lord."

questions.question: I will rejoice and be glad in your steadfast love, because you have seen my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:7 (ESV): "...because you have seen my affliction; you have known the distress of my soul,"

questions.question: You have not delivered me into the hand of the enemy; you have set my feet in a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:8 (ESV): "...you have set my feet in a broad place."

questions.question: Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I am in distress; my eye is wasted from what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:9 (ESV): "...my eye is wasted from grief; my soul and my body also."

questions.question: For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:10 (ESV): "For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with sighing;"

questions.question: But I trust in you, O Lord; I say, "You are my what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:14 (ESV): "But I trust in you, O Lord; I say, 'You are my God.'"

questions.question: My times are in your hand; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:15 (ESV): "...rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from my persecutors!"

questions.question: Make your face shine on your servant; save me in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:16 (ESV): "Make your face shine on your servant; save me in your steadfast love!"

questions.question: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak insolently against the righteous in pride and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:18 (ESV): "...which speak insolently against the righteous in pride and contempt."

questions.question: Love the Lord, all you his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 31:23 (ESV): "Love the Lord, all you his saints!"

key_verse_text: But I trust in you, O Lord; I say, "You are my God." My times are in your hand; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from my persecutors!
